'''Skive Idræts Klub''', commonly known as '''Skive IK''', '''SIK''' (especially locally) or simply '''Skive''', is a Danish professional [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Skive, Denmark|Skive]], [[Central Denmark Region]]. Founded in 1901, the club is affiliated with the [[DBU Jutland]] association and play their home games at [[Skive Stadium|Hancock Arena]]. The club colours are yellow and blue."}}
